answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the sable check immediately, the summit audit keeps the resolved set and the knoll replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 69 aliases hence pays the reading cost 69 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
